title: Overfitting
approval: Self-reviewed under explicit user authorization for the legacy redesign batch.
refinements: First draft rejected for two Guide buttons and an incorrect logarithmic loss view; accepted second draft restores one CTA and a linear scale.
Use exact engine curves, dots, loss values and bounds; raster geometry is illustrative.
Fit axes include all sampled curves across degrees and observed points; stay fixed for the current scenario/noise.
Negative gaps are possible in these constructed noise patterns, without an unsupported claim of random chance.
Use shared immediate explanation feedback and vertically stacked optional details for narrow containers.
Keep the fixed tiny numerical fitting penalty and QR method in optional evidence; remove preset underfit/overfit degree thresholds.
Start the first experiment at degree 1 to align the initial plot with its prediction; place axis names away from numeric tick labels.
